description: This file defines the USBDevice class within the WPEFramework Plugin namespace, including its nested Notification class. It declares interfaces, methods, and members related to USB device management and event notifications, serving as a header for USB device plugin implementation.

classes.name: USBDevice
classes.description: Represents a USB device plugin implementing IPlugin and JSONRPC interfaces, managing USB device events and notifications.

classes.name: Notification
classes.description: Nested class within USBDevice that handles remote connection and USB device notifications, including device plug-in and plug-out events.

methods.name: Initialize
methods.description: Initializes the USBDevice plugin with the provided service.

methods.name: Information
methods.description: Returns information about the USBDevice plugin.

methods.name: Deactivated
methods.description: Handles deactivation of a remote connection.
